name: qfn-power-fanout
prompt: Can you show me how to bring a 5 V rail into a QFN power pad? Use JLC04161H_7628 and a generated QFN-32 at 0.5 mm pitch (skill defaults: 32 leads and 0.5 mm pitch). The power class is 0.5 mm wide (skill default: 0.5 mm). I want a visible tag-based step-down on only the short pad escape. Derive the escape width and clearance from the actual landpattern and substrate, then build and read both route widths back.
expected_output: A reference design and explanation that keep the 0.5 mm power-class trunk (skill default: 0.5 mm), derive the narrowest selected QFN pad width and adjacent-pad gap with jitx.query, round the narrowest width to fixed 1 nm precision and subtract one 1 nm quantum so the escape stays strictly inside every selected pad, derive clearance from FabricationConstraints plus a labeled skill-default margin, split the route at a RoutePoint, tag only the escape Route, store routes and rules structurally, capture the design, and reject empty traces, Polygon realizations without a width, or realized widths that differ from the class and derived escape widths.

assertions.text: the reference module and capture checker type-check against the installed jitx package
the reference builds, captures, has non-empty traces, and realizes the trunk and escape at their expected widths

the escape width is derived strictly inside the narrowest selected placed-pad copper by fixed-precision rounding followed by an unconditional one-quantum subtraction, and is not typed as a package answer
the solution does not use a RoutingStructure neckdown region for the package escape
QfnEscapeTag is assigned to the escape Route segment, while PowerTag remains on the 5 V net

inputs.environment: Commands run from the repository root with python3 resolving to the project interpreter that has jitx installed.
